SILT#00087: There is a configuration for VSCode-like editors which allows nesting files under another file with the `explorer.fileNesting.*` options. Set `.enabled` to true and `.patterns` to a key-value mapping head file to nested files. Check out <https://github.com/antfu/vscode-file-nesting-config?tab=readme-ov-file#update-manually> for a quick start
